note: One row per thing we measure. Layers: L0 commodity, L2 routing brain (our policy and receipts), L3 OmS (our packaged layer), L4 public template. 'measured' stays null until receipts from a lab run exist.

items.name: opencode, no plugin
items.role: Control arm: what a user gets with no layer from us.

items.name: now: opencode + OmO 5.1.40 + routing brain + Token Pass
items.role: The working harness today. Its OmO config is the OLD generator output until PR 377 merges and the generator is re-run.

evidence.claim: Token Pass call resolved to token-pass; a 403 fallback walk succeeded.
evidence.caveat: Single live proof, not a benchmark.

items.name: OmS (oh my starlight): config, governance and receipts pack on upstream OmO
items.licence: ours; must not copy OmO source (SUL-1.0)
items.role: Our layer. No fork. Generated from routing.schema.json, with a free profile and a Token Pass profile.

evidence.claim: gen_omo_config.py generates an OmO config from the routing schema.
evidence.caveat: Profiles are not split yet; PR 377 changes its fallbacks.

items.name: starlight-ai-harness: public template repo
items.role: OmS plus playbooks, evals and setup docs, with no private state. Published only after the OmS evals pass.

items.name: native omo (senpi, a pi fork)
items.role: Holds the 'mass ulw' swarm. Tested in EXP-002 and EXP-003.

evidence.claim: One vendor benchmark: pi 20/30 vs oh-my-pi 17/30 at about a quarter of the cost per success.
evidence.source: Composio blog on pi vs omp
evidence.caveat: Vendor blog, one model, 30 tasks. Motivates the test only.

items.name: Claude Code (subscription)
items.role: Primary interactive harness. Subscription spend is not visible to the router, so its tasks need receipts written by a wrapper to be comparable.

evidence.claim: Four harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code, Hermes, Codex CLI) each completed a real traced model run.

items.name: Codex CLI
items.role: Independent verifier harness. Rejected 15 of 15 earlier Claude PRs with real security bugs, and has returned CHANGES REQUESTED on every PR 377 round so far.

evidence.claim: Cross-family review catches defects the author's family misses.
evidence.source: memory: estate absorb pipeline 2026-10-01; PR 377 rounds 1-4
evidence.caveat: Small sample; not yet scored as a harness.
